caption: The simplest trick for happiness is putting your phone away for a moment #usahealth #wellness #wellnessjourney #healthybodyhealthymind
transcript: Below this towel is the worst enemy of happiness. It is the phone. This small screen keeps you from yourself. When you feel lonely, your hand reaches for the phone. You look for connection there, but it is not real connection. It is endless scrolling. It is comparing. It is feeling left out. Take the screen away for a moment. Feel your own quiet. Listen to your own breath. Let your eyes rest. This is where peace lives, not in the phone. Your happiness is found in stillness, not in the small screen in your hand. For those who wish to go deeper, my book, Healing the Modern Soul, is in my bio.
